insights.summary: FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹2,509 Cr (up from ₹2,019 Cr), EBITDA ₹444 Cr and PAT about ₹272 Cr; Q4 consolidated revenue ₹783 Cr. Management again missed its own targets: FY26 revenue was first guided at ₹3,500 Cr, then ₹2,500-2,600 Cr, and the order book ended at ₹5,000 Cr against ₹8,000 Cr promised. For FY27 they gave a more modest outlook of about ₹3,250 Cr (35-40% growth) with 15-17% EBITDA margin, and said new capacity at Changodar slips to Q2 FY27.

what_changed.text: FY27 revenue outlook of about ₹3,250 Cr, described as conservative after FY26 misses
FY26 order book closed at about ₹5,000 Cr against the ₹8,000 Cr guided; management says it is choosing orders deliverable within 24 months
Changodar expansion moved to Q2 FY27 because of the extended monsoon; Moraiya expansion after this monsoon
Backward integration (CTC, pressboard, bushings, CRGO) on track, adding 200-300 bps of margin from FY28

tone.label: defensive
tone.quote: We have realized -- Raj, we have realized this. And that is why this year, we have given an outlook of INR 3,250 crores, not beyond that.

analyst_questions.answer: Management said it deliberately slowed order intake to keep deliveries within 24 months, and gave a lower FY27 outlook.
Current orders were taken 12-15 months ago at lower margins; new orders are chosen for margin, and backward integration should add 200-300 bps.
Utilities delayed March payments; about ₹200 Cr of the ₹410 Cr rise was collected in the first 15 days of April.
First HVDC repair order from PGCIL; empanelment possible 6 months after the repaired unit works well. HVDC transformers are about 40% of project cost.

red_flags.text: Second year of missed guidance: FY26 revenue target cut from ₹3,500 Cr to ₹2,500-2,600 Cr, order book ₹5,000 Cr vs ₹8,000 Cr promised.
Two FY27 numbers don't match: ₹3,250 Cr is about 30% growth on consolidated FY26, but the CFO also said 35-40%.
Margin guidance changed within the call: 16.5-17%, 15-16% and 15-17%.
Receivables up about ₹410 Cr and inventory doubled in FY26.
Open World Bank matter; management expected closure within 45 days.

watch_next: Changodar expansion running by Q2 FY27 and utilisation climbing towards 80% by Q3
Order inflow quality and size after the self-imposed 24-month delivery limit

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Power, distribution and specialty transformers (furnace, rectifier, reactors) from 33 kV up to 1,200 kV; entering HVDC via a PGCIL repair order
business_snapshot.customers: About 55% state and central utilities (PGCIL, state transcos), 20% EPC contractors, rest private customers
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Mostly domestic; minimal exports. Unexecuted order book about ₹5,000 Cr at March 2026 (18 months of revenue)
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Transmission capex, renewables integration, India's power demand; capacity rising from about 40,000 to 75,000 MVA
